_comment: How the sounds share the mix so a big fight stays readable (source/match/environment/WarSounds.gd and Soundscape.gd). Bus effects (the limiter, the sidechain ducking, the distance filter) are in default_bus_layout.tres.
_comment_density: in any density_window_s, once density_max sounds have played, a new one quieter than mask_below times the loudest of them is dropped unless its kind's priority (data/sounds/combat.json) is at least keep_priority: in a crowd, quiet sounds only add mush
_comment_distance: sounds further than far_from of the hearing range, and fights in the fog, play through the EffectsFar bus, which takes the top off them like air over distance
